summary: Phase-5 Iteration-4 (lifecycle-proof, execution immutability, replay risk summary) testing complete. All 5 backend tests passed. Lifecycle-proof endpoint correctly returns blocked status with machine-readable blocker report and fallback replay evidence file. Execution/order alias endpoint preserves venue-context error contract. Execution immutability verified (update attempts rejected with execution_metric_immutable). Correction events append-only model working. Replay risk-summary endpoint returns all required metrics with deterministic export JSON file. Frontend regression verified: User Exchange Settings page and Admin Exchanges page both load correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/exchange/lifecycle-proof correctly returns lifecycle_proof_status (blocked/completed/fallback_generated), evidence_type, exchange/market_type/environment, reason_codes, exchange_evidence_file, fallback_replay_evidence_file
Exchange evidence file includes readiness snapshot with validation details when blocked
Fallback replay evidence file includes schema_version, evidence_type=fallback_replay, non_live_evidence=true, lifecycle_distribution
POST /api/exchange/execution/order alias endpoint works and returns venue-context error contract (failure_code, exchange, market_type, environment) on 400
ExecutionMetric before_update hook correctly raises ValueError('execution_metric_immutable') preventing row updates

GET /api/backtest/replay/{run_id}/risk-summary returns all required risk metrics: schema_version, run_id, strategy_version, max_drawdown, sharpe, win_rate, profit_factor, avg_slippage_bps, volatility_bucket, regime_bucket_distribution, exposure_breach_count, risk_reject_count, evidence_type, export_file
Risk summary export JSON file has deterministic schema with same run_id and schema_version as endpoint response

success_rate.frontend: 100% (user exchange settings + admin exchanges pages verified)

seed_data_creation: Replay runs created during testing for risk-summary verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-5 Iteration-4 lifecycle-proof, execution immutability, and replay risk summary features fully tested. Key behaviors verified: (1) lifecycle-proof returns blocked status with blocker report + fallback replay evidence when key blocked, (2) execution/order alias preserves venue-context error contract, (3) execution rows immutable (before_update hook rejects changes), (4) correction events append-only working via POST/GET endpoints, (5) replay risk-summary returns all required metrics with deterministic JSON export, (6) frontend regression passed for user exchange settings and admin exchanges pages. Binance testnet key intentionally blocked so lifecycle-proof returns blocked/fallback_generated which is expected.

lifecycle_proof_pipeline.blocked_status_with_blocker_report: POST /api/exchange/lifecycle-proof returns lifecycle_proof_status='blocked' or 'fallback_generated', exchange_evidence_file with blocker payload
lifecycle_proof_pipeline.fallback_replay_evidence: fallback_replay_evidence_file generated with schema_version, evidence_type='fallback_replay', non_live_evidence=true, lifecycle_distribution
lifecycle_proof_pipeline.response_contract: lifecycle_proof_status, evidence_type, exchange, market_type, environment, reason_codes, exchange_evidence_file, fallback_replay_evidence_file, replay_run_id, message, generated_at

execution_order_alias.venue_context_error_contract: 400 response includes failure_code, exchange, market_type, environment

execution_immutability.correction_events_append_only: POST /api/exchange/execution/{execution_id}/corrections creates new correction event, GET returns all corrections

replay_risk_summary.endpoint_returns_metrics: GET /api/backtest/replay/{run_id}/risk-summary returns schema_version, run_id, strategy_version, max_drawdown, sharpe, win_rate, profit_factor, avg_slippage_bps, volatility_bucket, regime_bucket_distribution, exposure_breach_count, risk_reject_count, evidence_type, export_file, generated_at
replay_risk_summary.deterministic_export: Export JSON file has same run_id and schema_version as endpoint response

regression_verified.replay_run_detail_endpoint: GET /api/backtest/replay/run/{run_id} returns run detail with executions
regression_verified.user_exchange_settings_page: Frontend page loads with Overview, Risk Settings, Test & Validation tabs
regression_verified.admin_exchanges_page: Frontend page loads with Exchange Registry CRUD, Capability CRUD, Allowed Markets CRUD, User Assignment Matrix

mocked_api_note: No mocked APIs. Live lifecycle proof blocked due to intentionally invalid Binance key; fallback replay evidence generated as expected per design.
